DLF07_A.copy: Hook: Friday story night, the picture book lying open on the child's bed under the lamp, the spot where her granddaughter leaned away.
DLF07_A.prompt: Phone photo taken at about 8 p.m. in a child's small bedroom in a South Dakota house in early autumn, lit only by a bedside lamp with a warm fabric shade, slightly underexposed corners. On a twin bed with a lavender quilt, an open hardcover picture book lies face up, its pages showing a simple painted night forest with a small owl on a branch, no words visible. The pillow has a dent where a child was leaning, pushed toward the far side of the bed; a stuffed rabbit lies there. At the foot of the bed, a pair of reading glasses rests on the quilt. A sippy cup and a night-light on the nightstand. IMPORTANT: the book's pages show only illustration, no readable text; no cartoon characters from any franchise; no logos. Ordinary lamp light, slight grain, crooked framing.

DLF07_B.copy: The analogy: a worn, sour kitchen sponge sitting on the edge of the sink.
DLF07_B.prompt: Close-up phone photo taken from standing height at a white enamel kitchen sink in an older home, morning daylight from a window over the sink. On the edge of the sink sits a worn rectangular kitchen sponge, yellow on top with a green scrub side, gray and flattened in the middle, a little damp and frayed at the corners. Behind it, a plain clear bottle of yellow lemon dish soap with no label and a coffee mug in the basin. A dish towel hangs over the faucet. IMPORTANT: the dish soap bottle has no label, logo or readable text. Flat ordinary daylight, slightly overexposed window, not styled.

DLF07_C.copy: Gail at the coffee table in the church fellowship hall after choir practice, talking with a hand held near her mouth.
DLF07_C.prompt: Candid phone photo taken by a friend across a folding table in a plain church fellowship hall on a Wednesday evening in autumn: beige cinderblock walls, fluorescent ceiling lights, a large stainless coffee urn and a plate of cookies on a paper tablecloth. A 66-year-old white woman with short ash-blond hair and glasses, wearing a burgundy cardigan over a striped top, is talking to another woman in her 60s, and holds her fingers in front of her lips while she speaks, eyes a little self-conscious. Paper coffee cups, a folded paper bulletin with no readable text, coats over chair backs. IMPORTANT: no religious symbols, no crosses, no signs or readable text, no logos. Flat fluorescent light, slight green cast, ordinary unposed snapshot.

DLF07_D.copy: Payoff: Lily, 6, on Gail's lap up by the pillow, both laughing over the owl book; the opening image reversed.
DLF07_D.prompt: Candid phone photo taken by the girl's mother from the bedroom doorway at night, lamp light and a little flash. In the same child's bedroom with the lavender quilt, a 66-year-old white woman with short ash-blond hair and glasses, in a soft gray sweater, sits propped up against the pillows with a 6-year-old girl with light brown hair in pajamas on her lap. The grandmother is mid-laugh, mouth open, holding an open picture book with a painted owl on the page; the girl leans back into her, laughing with her eyes squeezed shut. A stuffed rabbit tucked beside them. Season early winter: a fleece blanket over their legs, dark window. IMPORTANT: the woman's teeth are realistic, natural-looking dentures; no distorted mouths or teeth; the book shows only illustration, no readable text; no franchise characters or logos. Warm ordinary lamp light, slight grain, crooked framing.
